title: Android emulator re-verification of the full player journey on the combat-merged candidate

build.python_core: chaquopy embeds vnext/backend/src directly; the build therefore includes the combat capability, d20 template, genre presets and SillyTavern interop merges

model.probe: passed via Android UI: 可用 · protocol response contains content

journey: New AI world draft 潮汐之门 (theme/tone/conflict kept from the form) generated with qwen2.5:7b and passed local rule validation; the takeover banner confirmed chapters/choices/endings were engine-authored.
Confirmed the draft, composed the world and entered a new run as 林若兮; the opening story beat showed location, protagonist, NPC dialogue, objective, guidance and two choices.
Completed 10 model-backed turns: route lock (林若兮路线), chapter progression 线索推进 2→7, structured NPC initiatives (林若兮/李老渔/墨离/云影) with pending-interaction feedback and choices fixed at the bottom.
One turn exceeded the 120s model timeout; the failure banner showed 原状态未改变 / 没有写入结果 (zero-write boundary) with a retry action.
Retried the final-chapter choice; the model returned after the host slept, and after a force-stop + relaunch the completed run restored correctly showing 旅程完成·好结局 at 第10回合.
World list showed 潮汐之门 with the completed journey; 开始新旅程 created an independent second run with a different hero (旅行者) and opened a fresh opening beat with its own choices.

verification.combat_no_regression: the whole journey ran on the merged core (chaquopy-embedded backend/src); engine-level combat coverage remains in vnext/backend tests (test_combat.py, test_d20_frontier.py). AI-drafted worlds do not enable the combat capability, matching the ruleset design.
verification.timeout_zero_write: observed on screen; retry succeeded without duplicating state
verification.force_stop_recovery: completed run restored after am force-stop + relaunch

findings: UI refresh gap: after the retried turn succeeded while the app stayed foreground during a host sleep, the play screen kept showing stale history until force-stop + relaunch; data was never lost (recovered from the local store). Registered as a desktop/mobile polish item, not a data-integrity defect.
NPC-initiative interstitials keep the choice area stable, which made adb coordinate tapping reliable.

score.reason: journey fully reproduced post-merge including failure and recovery paths; minor deduction for the stale-UI-after-background-refresh gap observed on the play screen.
